name: issue-board
description: The repository's open GitHub issues and pull requests in a pane and under the prompt, with acceptance progress and CI, and a button that hands an issue to Claude.

autoMove.title: Move issues on their own
autoMove.description: Move closed issues to Done, an issue a pull request names with Refs to Verification when it merges, and epics with their sub-issues: In progress when one starts, and closed or at Verification when the last one closes. Each move needs its Status role; set a role to none in /issues statuses to skip that move. It changes the shared project from your session.

claimOnStart.title: Start assigns and moves the issue
claimOnStart.description: Start, and Claude starting on an issue, assign it to you and move it to In progress.

startMode.title: Where Start works
startMode.description: main starts an issue in this chat. background makes Start in background the first button, on s, and the system prompt tells Claude to hand issues to background workers and then review, check and merge or report their pull requests. The main-chat Start moves to b.

workingNote.title: Working note in the system prompt
workingNote.description: While Claude works on an issue you started, the system prompt names it and says how to tick its boxes and change it.

closesWhenTicked.title: Closes only when every box is ticked
closesWhenTicked.description: The working note and the background agent tell Claude to write Closes #N in a pull request only when every box of the issue is ticked, and Refs #N otherwise. Off, they say nothing about it. Moves to Verification on a Refs merge rely on it.

capture.title: Capture section in the system prompt
capture.description: The system prompt tells Claude to file work it finds in conversation, such as follow-ups and bugs noticed in passing, to the Inbox with the capture tool instead of listing it in chat.

issueCopies.title: Copies of issues a prompt names
issueCopies.description: A prompt that names #123 carries the board's copy of that issue or pull request, unseen.

suggestNextStep.title: Suggest the next step
suggestNextStep.description: After Claude's turn, the prompt box suggests the next step for the issue Claude is on, in place of Claude Code's own suggestion.

followBranch.title: Follow the branch
followBranch.description: Checking out a branch named for an issue, such as fix/315-glide, makes it the issue Claude is on.

band.title: Band above the prompt
band.description: The band above the prompt raises what needs you: setup problems, failing or passing CI, news on your issue, boxes to tick, plans to approve, epic notes, a project to adopt, guesses to confirm, and captures to the Inbox.

refresh.title: How often the board reads GitHub
refresh.description: Every 5, 15 or 60 minutes, or manual: only on /issues refresh, r, and after Claude's turns that ran git or gh. Reads come from the account's shared rate limit.

writeProjects.title: Projects the board may write to
writeProjects.description: The GitHub projects the board may change, as owner/number split by commas, such as astrosteveo/9, astrosteveo/8. In a repo, the board writes only to the project it reads there, or one linked to it, and only when it is listed here or in the repo's own .claude/settings.json. Empty means the board only reads. Let it write, Apply in /issues setup and the project_adopt tool add a project, and Release removes it.
